noun_definition: Chat refers to the messaging functionality within the app where users can mention others by typing '@' followed by their display name, which may include special characters like '#'.
App refers to the software application being used to interact with reports and manage user mentions within the context of the issue.
Selection refers to the action of choosing a user from the mention results after typing '@#' in the app.

Mention refers to the action of referencing a user in the app by typing '@' followed by their display name, which includes a '#' character, in order to select and replace it with the user's actual name in the text.
